mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_pending_handoff ( outbox_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, request_fingerprint_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, conversation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, summary_text TEXT NOT NULL, request_title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, request_description TEXT NOT NULL, customer_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, product_line VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, issue_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, priority_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, failure_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, attempt_count INT NOT NULL, next_attempt_at BIGINT NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (outbox_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_cs_pending_handoff_tenant_idempotency (tenant_id, idempotency_key), INDEX idx_cs_pending_handoff_due (status, next_attempt_at), INDEX idx_cs_pending_handoff_tenant_review (tenant_id, status, updated_at, outbox_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_pending_handoff_result ( tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, ticket_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ticket_status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, ticket_created_at VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, recorded_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, idempotency_key) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_pending_handoff_claim ( tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, owner_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lease_until BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, idempotency_key), INDEX idx_cs_pending_handoff_claim_lease (lease_until) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_pending_handoff_review_audit ( audit_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, outbox_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, actor_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, authority_used VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, decision_note VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, evidence_source VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, from_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, to_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, from_version BIGINT NOT NULL, to_version BIGINT NOT NULL, review_failure_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, attempt_count_at_decision INT NOT NULL, scheduled_at BIGINT NULL, occurred_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (audit_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_cs_pending_handoff_review_audit_transition (tenant_id, outbox_id, to_version), INDEX idx_cs_pending_handoff_review_audit_page (tenant_id, outbox_id, occurred_at, audit_id) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_pending_handoff( outbox_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint_hash, user_id, conversation_id, reason, summary_text, request_title, request_description, customer_id, product_line, issue_type, priority_code, status, failure_type, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{outboxId}, #{command.tenantId}, #{command.request.idempotencyKey}, #{fingerprint}, #{command.userId}, #{command.conversationId}, #{command.reason}, #{command.summary}, #{command.request.title}, #{command.request.description}, #{command.request.customerId}, #{command.request.productLine}, #{command.request.issueType}, #{command.request.priority}, #{status}, #{failureType}, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, 1, #{now}, #{now} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key FROM cs_pending_handoff WHERE status IN ('PREPARED', 'RESULT_UNKNOWN', 'RETRY_SCHEDULED', 'PROCESSING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cs_pending_handoff_result AS result_row WHERE result_row.tenant_id = cs_pending_handoff.tenant_id AND result_row.idempotency_key = cs_pending_handoff.idempotency_key ) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, outbox_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT outbox_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint_hash, user_id, conversation_id, reason, summary_text, request_title, request_description, customer_id, product_line, issue_type, priority_code, status, failure_type, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM cs_pending_handoff WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key FROM cs_pending_handoff WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND outbox_id = #{outboxId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key FROM cs_pending_handoff WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
